name: Finance Receipt Intake
description: One verified external receipt record with original evidence retained, safe proof refs, and an IMAP acknowledgement only after the host completes the common intake contract.
audience: US solo entrepreneurs who need a dependable receipt inbox without moving financial evidence into StackOS
problem: Receipts arrive through email, chat, and manual uploads, and are easy to lose, duplicate, or acknowledge before the underlying record is durable.
outcome: One verified external receipt record with original evidence retained, safe proof refs, and an IMAP acknowledgement only after the host completes the common intake contract.
whyAi: An agent can coordinate bounded provider transport, duplicate checks, and host-file verification while leaving custody and accounting judgment with the selected backend and owner.
operatorPath: Forward receipts to the configured mailbox or upload originals/screenshots in chat; the agent resolves workspace defaults.
Start a manual or explicit external-trigger intake and choose IMAP, chat, or manual-upload evidence.
Review one consolidated list of material exceptions; credentials belong only in Connections, while receipt uploads use the host chat attachment channel.
agentPath: Confirm the external workspace is readable and writable before any IMAP export.
For IMAP, search a bounded candidate page, stage exactly one message, and validate the host handoff.
Use the common external intake contract to deduplicate, atomically retain originals, update finance.json, and re-read the result.
Only after verified external persistence, acknowledge the matching UIDVALIDITY/UID and clean up the staged transfer.
recovery: If the workspace, hashes, paths, or finance.json re-read fail, stop before acknowledgement and retain only a safe exception reference.
If acknowledgement is unknown or fails, preserve the verified external record and transfer id, then retry the same epoch-qualified acknowledgement without re-ingesting it.
safeStoppingPoints: Stop after a staged candidate when host verification cannot proceed.
Stop after the external record is verified but before acknowledgement when the mailbox epoch or provider result is uncertain.

handoffs.when: A receipt is accepted or matched in the selected external backend and its bookkeeping work remains prepared/unposted.

prerequisites: An explicitly selected external backend and writable workspace
Host access to the selected workspace and the uploaded originals or IMAP staging route
A verified SSL or STARTTLS IMAP connection only when the IMAP route is selected
proof: Safe external receipt-record and host-write proof refs
Safe source identity and hash/path verification refs
Epoch-qualified acknowledgement and cleanup state when IMAP is selected
whenToUse: A receipt, invoice attachment, screenshot, or other evidence must enter the selected finance backend through the common intake protocol.
A dedicated receipt mailbox has a bounded candidate message that needs store-before-ack handling.

stages.title: Preflight External Backend And Route
stages.summary: Resolve workspace defaults, host access, and the selected route without requiring tax classification.

stages.title: Discover Or Receive One Candidate
stages.summary: Obtain one bounded candidate without treating it as an accepted receipt.

stages.title: Stage IMAP Evidence
stages.summary: Stage exactly one IMAP message through the bounded communications connector when the IMAP route is selected.

stages.title: Validate And Write External Record
stages.summary: Apply the external backend's duplicate, quarantine, atomic original-write, finance.json update, and re-read protocol.

stages.title: Acknowledge Verified IMAP Evidence
stages.summary: Mark the exact message seen only after the host proves external persistence.

stages.title: Clean Up Completed IMAP Staging
stages.summary: Remove connector staging after a proven acknowledgement while preserving external evidence and safe recovery state.
